stories.title: LSU New Orleans names first chancellor since rejoining LSU system
stories.summary: LSU New Orleans rejoined the LSU system on July 1.

stories.title: Man injured after being shot several times in Metairie, deputy says
stories.summary: The shooting in the Bonnabel Place neighborhood happened around 1:30 p.m., the sheriff's office said.

stories.title: Remains of 3 adults, 3 children found after plane leaving New Orleans crashes near Horn Island
stories.summary: Around 11:30 p.m. Tuesday, the Coast Guard said it concluded it's search after recovering the victim's bodies.

stories.title: Louisiana seeks additional information from SpaceX on coastal permit
stories.summary: State officials say the temporary permit hold is a routine administrative step as regulators seek additional environmental information from SpaceX.

stories.title: Gov. Landry announces $35 million plan to cover Belle Chasse Bridge tolls for 5 years
stories.summary: Gov. Jeff Landry announced a $35 million deal that could cover Belle Chasse Bridge tolls for eligible drivers for five years, though no start date is set.

stories.title: St. Tammany Parish burn ban lifted ahead of holiday bonfires
stories.summary: St. Tammany Parish has lifted its burn ban following weeks of drought concerns, allowing residents to resume outdoor burning with safety precautions.

stories.title: 2 men face manslaughter charge for Central City second-line shooting, NOPD says
stories.summary: Two men face manslaughter charges in the fatal shooting of a 26-year-old woman who was trying to leave a Central City second-line in November 2025, NOPD says.

stories.title: Hundreds without power in Orleans Parish
stories.summary: Entergy's outage map showed outages in the Venetian Isles and Carrollton Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Parts of Metairie could be without water for hours after main break
stories.summary: Jefferson Parish estimates service could be restored around 3 p.m. Wednesday. No boil water advisory is in effect.

stories.title: Links on 4: News Links
stories.summary: Watch the WWL Louisiana News team every day on WWL-TV and WUPL.

stories.title: Thanksgiving break in New Orleans: Events and things to do
stories.summary: Aside from tuning in to watch NFL games on Turkey Day or setting the table for a feast with all the fixings, there's plenty to see and do if you're in the city.

stories.title: Kenner shop owner accused of installing secret camera in bathroom faces new charges
stories.summary: Henry Rios was arrested in September after Kenner police said they confiscated several recording devices from his home and business.
